demos.name: SimpleSnackbar
demos.description: The Snackbar component appears temporarily and floats above the UI to provide users with (non-critical) updates on an app's processes.

demos.name: PositionedSnackbar
demos.description: Use the anchorOrigin prop to control the Snackbar's position on the screen.

demos.name: LongTextSnackbar
demos.description: Use the Snackbar Content component to add text and actions to the Snackbar.

demos.name: AutohideSnackbar
demos.description: Make sure to provide sufficient time for the user to process the information displayed on it.

demos.name: TransitionsSnackbar
demos.description: Use slots.transition and slotProps.transition to change the transition of the Snackbar from Grow (the default) to others such as Slide.

demos.name: CustomizedSnackbars
demos.description: Use an Alert inside a Snackbar for messages that communicate a certain severity.

demos.name: FabIntegrationSnackbar
demos.section: Customization › Use with Floating Action Buttons
demos.description: If you're using a Floating Action Button on mobile, Material Design recommends positioning snackbars directly above it, as shown in the demo below:

demos.name: ConsecutiveSnackbars
demos.description: This demo shows how to display multiple Snackbars without stacking them by using a consecutive animation.

demos.name: IntegrationNotistack
demos.description: With an imperative API, notistack lets you vertically stack multiple Snackbars without having to handle their open and close states.
